name: Data Exfiltration & DNS Tunneling Incident Runbook
containment_steps: Block destination IP/C2 domain at external DNS resolver and edge proxy
Sinkhole suspicious authoritative nameserver domains immediately
Temporarily disconnect suspected internal transmitting endpoint
investigation_steps: Quantify volume of data transferred using Zeek conn.log or NetFlow
Analyze query entropy and subdomain length in Zeek dns.log to confirm tunneling
Identify originating user account and process ID responsible for traffic
remediation_steps: Implement DNS response rate limiting and block non-standard DNS resolvers
Conduct sensitive data breach assessment to evaluate regulatory impact
Retain network flow records and PCAP files for forensic chain of custody
